budget_items.topic: Eagle Scout loafing shed remaining cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Thomas Carey estimated the remaining cost of the shed at about $1,900 after donated materials; the DPW Director said the cost could be accommodated within the DPW budget; Carey said he expected the Town to fund the materials.
budget_items.quote: estimated the remaining cost at approximately $1,900

budget_items.topic: Superintendent's initial state aid proposal vs. unappropriated state aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The superintendent's initial proposal discussed July 8 totaled more than the then-identified unappropriated state aid.
budget_items.quote: the superintendent's initial proposal discussed at a july 8 meeting totaled $477,896, exceeding the then-identified $471,121 in unappropriated state aid

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The general-government increase in additional state aid was approximately $73,998, and the Town had not yet discussed how to use that portion.
budget_items.quote: she noted that the general-government increase was approximately $73,998

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Committee approved a $350,000 spending plan on July 15 covering reading specialists, a high school assistant principal, music staffing, and tutoring licenses.
budget_items.quote: the school committee approved a $350,000 spending plan on july 15

budget_items.topic: Requested special Town Meeting article for additional state aid to the school department
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Committee requested an article at a November 2026 special Town Meeting to appropriate $350,000 in state aid; Vice-Chair Lehtinen said the request had shifted from approximately $418,000 in education funding.
budget_items.quote: expressed disappointment that the request had shifted from approximately $418,000 in education funding to $350,000

budget_items.topic: State budget size and net education aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Clerk McLeod cited a state budget of approximately $63.4 billion; the Chair said net education-related aid would be less than $418,000 after assessments.
budget_items.quote: the net education-related aid would be less than $418,000 after assessments
